nuhStyleFalsePositive.text: Welche Antwort passt zu „Ādam عليه السلام kennenlernen“ im Alltag?
nuhStyleFalsePositive.transcript: Welche Antwort passt zu Adam Alaihi Salam? Kennenlernen im Alltag
nuhStyleFalsePositive.reason: Scribe (deu) romanized عليه السلام as “Alaihi Salam”; phonetically correct, not a regen case. German overlap 1.0.
